title: Peanut Butter, Tahini & Dark Chocolate Oat Cookies
description: Oat cookies with peanut butter, tahini, almond flour, honey, pumpkin seeds and dark chocolate. Current almond-flour batch with no added milk.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 175°C (350°F) and line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Mix the peanut butter, tahini, honey, sugar, egg and vanilla together until smooth.
Stir the baking soda and fine salt thoroughly into the wet mixture so they disperse evenly before the dough thickens.
Fold the dark chocolate and pumpkin seeds into the wet mixture before adding the oats.
Add the rolled oats and almond flour last, and fold just until combined. The dough gets clumpy quickly, so make sure all the other ingredients are mixed evenly first. No added milk in this version.
Scoop dough onto the lined tray, leave space between cookies, and flatten slightly. The number of cookies depends on scoop size.
Bake at 175°C (350°F) for about 9–11 minutes; check earlier if making smaller cookies.
Leave the cookies on the tray for about 5 minutes before moving them.

notes: Latest almond-flour batch: 40 g honey, 9 g sugar, 30 g dark chocolate, 10 g pumpkin seeds only, and no milk.
Mix the baking soda, salt, chocolate and pumpkin seeds into the wet mixture before adding the oats and almond flour, because the oats make the dough clumpy and hard to mix evenly.
This uses peanut butter, not almond butter.
Cookie count depends on how large you scoop them.
